referenceSources.description:
A striking yellow Lamborghini Countach, decked out in Art Sports, Valvoline, and rain‑X decals, roars around a racetrack under bright conditions. The number 88 on its doors and roof identifies the JLOC entry, showcasing a wide aerodynamic body, prominent rear wing, and low‑profile racing slicks.

This photograph illustrates the culmination of JLOC’s three decades of dedication in GT racing. Since debuting the Countach in the 1994 JGTC series, team principal Noritake has pursued victory with Lamborghini machinery. The image captures both the car’s vivid livery and the high-speed intensity of professional motorsport.
